g.text: Monthly wind and latent-heat evidence through each event
Blue solid: weaker winds (+) · Orange dashed: less latent heat loss (+) · Shaded: February–June starts
ERA5 wind projection + NCEP-NCAR R1 flux. Separate physical axes; shared scales across events. 1991–2020 anomalies.
Two development years are shown for the 2014–16 event. These observed fields are not inputs to the existing forecasts.
